title: A novel, rapid, and practical prognostic model for sepsis patients based on dysregulated immune cell lactylation.

models.verbatim_formula: risk score = sum(multivariate Cox coefficient_i x expression_i) over 8 genes (coefficients in Suppl. Fig. S3B)
models.expression_scale_used: log2-transformed array expression (Methods: log2 transformation, genes with expression >0 retained); risk scores in Fig. S3C range about -12 to -5
models.cutoff: optimal cutoff from X-tile in training set (value not reported), applied unchanged to validation set
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 training (n=335): time AUC 0.77 (3 d), 0.77 (14 d), 0.78 (28 d); mortality AUC 0.78; KM log-rank p<0.0001. GSE65682 validation (n=144): time AUC 0.73/0.70/0.73; mortality AUC 0.73. Prospective in-house PBMC RT-qPCR cohort (n=51): 28-day mortality AUC 0.86; time AUC 0.69 (3 d), 0.82 (7 d), 0.80 (14 d), 0.86 (28 d).
models.source_location: Methods 'Construction of prognostic signature'; Results + Fig. 4; coefficients table and HRs in Supplementary Figure S3B (DataSheet1.pdf, page 3)

notes: Coefficients read from the table image in Supplementary Figure S3B (downloaded via Europe PMC supplementary zip to signatures/extraction/suppl/40612938/x/DataSheet1.pdf); they agree with the printed HRs (e.g. exp(0.665)=1.94 vs HR 1.945; exp(-0.947)=0.388 vs HR 0.388). Gene selection: lactylation consensus clusters (k-means on GSVA of 48 lactylation genes) -> DEGs cluster3 vs others intersected with DEGs non-survivor vs survivor -> univariate Cox -> LASSO + Elastic Net -> multivariate Cox, all in GSE65682 sepsis patients (n=479). GSE95233 (51 septic shock + 22 healthy) was used for GSEA, lactylation scoring, pseudotime and longitudinal risk-score dynamics by survival (no formal AUC validation) - listed as 'other' but it is used. External validation in an in-house cohort used RT-qPCR (beta-actin normalised), not a GEO dataset.
